_provenance: Hand-written summary of an IBM Bob 2.0 build session, authored for this repository. This is NOT a machine export from Bob. To substitute a real export, delete this file and replace it with the output of Bob's session export. See bob_sessions/README.md.
title: ADB dumpsys batterystats Parser
built: 7 TypeScript interfaces: DumpsysResult, PerUidEntry, WakelockEntry, NetworkEntry, DozeViolation, CpuWakeup, DumpsysDelta
parseWakelockHistory() - wakelock name, package, hold duration
parseNetworkStats() - bytes rx/tx per UID wifi vs mobile
parseDozeViolations() - Doze whitelist + idle exit detection
parseCpuWakeups() - wakeup alarm counts per package
computeDelta() - before/after subtraction, drain rate calculation
bob_reasoning: dumpsys batterystats output is semi-structured. Key insight: sections are identified by indented header lines, not by consistent delimiters. Each section parser uses line-by-line regex rather than a parser combinator. All parsing is defensive (try/catch per section) because real-world dumpsys output varies across Android versions (8 through 14). The computeDelta function uses a 3000mAh default battery capacity - conservative enough to avoid overestimating drain on modern devices.
